grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings exceed C threshold (max 2). Three P1s are critical CVEs (CVSS 9.8) in production dependencies escalated to TheGuardians; one P1 is a structural tooling blind spot.

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: AST type confusion allows arbitrary JavaScript injection via malformed template data. Fix: npm audit fix or pin handlebars >=4.7.9

escalations.title: Vitest UI Arbitrary File Read + RCE (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: Vitest UI server (no auth) allows unauthenticated file read and code execution. Fix: upgrade vitest >=4.1.10 (Source/Frontend), >=1.6.0 (portal/Frontend). Workaround: --ui=false in CI.

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: RCE vulnerability in protobufjs transitive dependency. Fix: npm audit fix in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend.
